name: Hareli Eco Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: The only sit-down restaurant inside Barnawapara Wildlife Sanctuary — Chhattisgarh Tourism's 12-cottage eco-resort kitchen, ~9 km from the main entry gate. TripAdvisor reviewers (4.7/5 across 20 reviews) consistently flag the food as the resort's strongest card; one calls it 'really commendable.' For a 245 sq km dry-deciduous sanctuary that holds gaur, sloth bear, leopard and chital, this is functionally the only post-safari meal that isn't a fried snack at the gate.
insider_tip: Order the Chhattisgarhi thali ahead of the standard Indian/Chinese menu — the kitchen does desi muga and chausela properly when notified. No cellular network or WiFi at the resort; carry cash or use the in-house tab. Lunch service ends by 13:30; pre-book if you've come on a day safari.
signature_address: Hareli Eco Resort, Mohda, Barnawapara Wildlife Sanctuary, Mahasamund District, Chhattisgarh 493551

name: Barnawapara Forest Rest House Mess
why_it_matters: The Chhattisgarh Forest Department runs its own mess for registered overnight guests at the Forest Rest House inside the sanctuary buffer — the meal foresters and ASI-attached researchers actually eat. No alcohol, no walk-ins, no à la carte; it is the deepest-inside dining option at Barnawapara.
insider_tip: Bookings only via the Chhattisgarh Forest Department portal (cgforest.com/barnawapara). Choose the food-inclusive tariff at booking — kitchen runs out of options once the duty roster eats. Solar + generator power; eat by 20:30 or sit by candle.
signature_address: Forest Rest House, Barnawapara Wildlife Sanctuary, Mahasamund District 493551

name: Mor Mahanadi Dhaba
why_it_matters: On the Mahasamund stretch of NH-353 — the highway most Barnawapara travellers drive in on from Raipur or out to Saraipali/Sambalpur — this is the named dhaba TripAdvisor reviewers actually finish a meal at. Trucker volume around lunch is the proxy for kitchen turnover; in the long road gap between Mahasamund town and the sanctuary turn-off, it is the realistic dinner stop.
insider_tip: Stick to the freshly-made daytime thali — avoid late-night non-veg unless you've watched it being cooked. Take a tea break here on the return drive; the next reliable kitchen is back in Mahasamund town.
signature_address: NH-353 Mahasamund-Saraipali stretch, Mahasamund District, Chhattisgarh

name: Sanctuary Gate Tea Stalls
why_it_matters: Two thatched chai stalls open at the sanctuary gate from ~05:30 to catch safari jeeps before the first drive — the only food economy at the sanctuary edge before the Hareli kitchen lights up at 07:00. TripAdvisor reviewers of the sanctuary repeatedly mention these as the pre-dawn chai before a sambar/gaur sighting.
insider_tip: Cash only, no UPI. Stalls shut once the morning safari window closes around 08:00 and reopen at 14:00 for the evening departures. Carry your own water; nothing bottled here past mid-morning.
signature_address: Outside Barnawapara Sanctuary main gate, Mahasamund District 493551
